meta.name: excalidraw-diagram-generator
meta.description: Generate Excalidraw diagrams from natural language descriptions. Use when asked to "create a diagram", "make a flowchart", "visualize a process", "draw a system architecture", "create a mind map", or "generate an Excalidraw file". Supports flowcharts, relationship diagrams, mind maps, and system architecture diagrams. Outputs .excalidraw JSON files that can be opened directly in Excalidraw.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言描述生成 Excalidraw 图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速将想法转化为可视化图表
copy.tagline_en: Generate Excalidraw diagrams from natural language descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn ideas into visual diagrams

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的文字描述自动生成 Excalidraw 格式的图表文件，包括流程图、关系图、思维导图、架构图等。
howto.when: 当你要求“创建图表”、“制作流程图”、“可视化流程”、“绘制系统架构”、“生成思维导图”或“生成 Excalidraw 文件”时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个用户注册的流程图。
用思维导图展示机器学习的主要概念。
say.note: Claude 会生成以“机器学习”为中心的思维导图。

say.text: 画一个用户、帖子、评论之间的关系图。
say.note: Claude 会生成实体关系图并标注联系。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate Excalidraw-format diagram files from your natural language descriptions, including flowcharts, relationship diagrams, mind maps, and architecture diagrams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "create a diagram", "make a flowchart", "visualize a process", "draw a system architecture", "generate a mind map", or "generate an Excalidraw file".

say_en.text: Create a flowchart for user registration.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an Excalidraw file with steps and arrows.

say_en.text: Make a mind map about machine learning concepts.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a mind map centered on 'Machine Learning'.

say_en.text: Diagram the relationship between User, Post, and Comment.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an entity-relationship diagram with labels.
